Rider and driver: this is decided on the record's measurements, not on who said what. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00101 (weight 1.0, 100% coverage, no gaps, 10 s sampling — so not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c)) measures the trip at 27.18 km against the booked optimal of 21.0 km on EV-TRIP-00101. Runner-and-driver agree on that much, and the trace figure governs under POL-RD-01: the excess is 6.18 km, 29.4% of the optimal route, clearing both establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km). It does NOT clear the materiality gates (over 50%, or over 8.0 km), so the deviation is established but not material, the remedy is confined to the POL-RD-02 arithmetic, and no POL-RD-06 full-refund uplift or conduct referral follows. The driver's own chat message at 10:42:05 ('sorry boss missed the exit, coming back now') and his counterparty statement ('I took a wrong turn at the MCE exit') admit the excess — they confirm the deviation, they do not excuse it. No exoneration applies: the rider asked for no detour (POL-RD-04 — the only rider messages are route complaints, every waypoint_hint is null, so the corroboration test cannot be run and no distance is excluded), no pickup or dropoff was amended (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not pooled (POL-RD-12). The bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00101-01, is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0); no LTA advisory existed for the AYE/MCE/ECP corridor in the trip window, so POL-RD-03's three-limb test cannot be run and the missed exit is a driver error, not an external traffic cause. On POL-RD-13: no party cited the absent advisory as an exculpatory artifact, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction and there is no escalation. On the money, read from EV-FARE-00101 (METERED, charged_total 35.64): recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 21.0 km + 0.28 × 26.0 min) × 1.0 surge multiplier + 0.80 platform fee = 27.63. Refund = 35.64 − 27.63 = 8.01, rounded up to SGD 8.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and far below 90% of the charge, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 8.05, not the $10.00 claimed. There is nothing to pass through under POL-RD-09: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00 and the airport surcharge is 0.00, so no off-route or phantom line is refundable. The rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d = 0) does not trigger enhanced corroboration. Confidence is capped at 1.0, the weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding facts — the trace (EV-GPS-00101) and the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00101), both 1.0. One procedural note: the monetary effect of SGD 8.05 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so the ruling issues but execution is held for human release; this does not change the ruling value.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Both parties' accounts point the same way, and the record decides the case.

Measuring the trip. The fare is metered (EV-FARE-00102, fare_model METERED), so the route-deviation rules apply. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH establishment tests to pass: an excess greater than 0.8 km AND greater than 20% of the optimal distance. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00102) is unbroken — 193 fixes, 10-second sampling against a 10-second expected interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, largest gap 0 seconds — and it measures 21.79 km over the trace polyline (the governing field; the trip record's rounded 21.8 km convenience copy may not be cited for the test). The platform's optimal distance is 20.4 km (EV-TRIP-00102). The excess is therefore 1.39 km, which is 6.81% of 20.4 km. It clears the absolute limb (1.39 km > 0.8 km) but fails the proportional limb (6.81%, well short of 20%). Both tests must pass, so no route deviation is established. The metered fare of SGD 29.91 that the rider paid stands; no part of the SGD 7.00 she contested is returned, and payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 is left as it is. POL-RD-02 does not run: its recomputation (which would give 27.46 and a 2.45 difference) applies only once a deviation is established, and none is. Both advocates read the arithmetic to the same conclusion and every claim on this point is accepted.

Why the driver's traffic excuse neither helps nor escalates. The driver's explanation — a slow crawl on the BKE near Dairy Farm — is an asserted external traffic cause, tested under POL-RD-13 against a traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00102-01, is MISSING: weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload, no coverage of the BKE or the Upper Bukit Timah corridor in the 11:16–11:55 window. The comparison POL-RD-03 requires cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It does not excuse anything — but nothing needs excusing, because the threshold already fails on the rider's own evidence. Because the driver named no advisory evidence ID, the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged.

Rider-requested detour. The only in-app message on this trip is the driver's own (EV-CHAT-00102, 'boss BKE quite jam, i go Upper Bukit Timah ok?', sent 11:29:04, read 11:29:40, never answered). It is not a rider instruction, carries waypoint_hint null and names no road with the specificity POL-RD-04 demands, so POL-RD-04 excludes nothing on the driver's behalf. No distance is excluded and no compensation arises: the rider was billed for 21.8 km against a trace of 21.79 km, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall to pay under POL-RD-04's compensation limb.

Billing integrity. EV-FARE-00102 itemises no ERP or toll gantry lines (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00, on- and off-optimal-route ERP totals 0.00) and no airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. Base fare 3.80, distance 16.35, time 8.96 and platform fee 0.80 reconcile to the metered rate card against the 29.91 charged. There is no phantom charge to refund under POL-RD-09(4), so no billing-integrity referral fires. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, so POL-RD-07's corroboration requirement and POL-RD-10(3) are not in play, and none of the POL-RD-06 driver-profile conditions is met (deviation_flags_90d 0), so no conduct referral fires either.

The precedents sharing these clauses (P-0001, P-0002) ended in partial refunds because their excess met the POL-RD-01 threshold; here the 6.81% proportional limb fails, and that is what makes the difference. The monetary effect is nil, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, and this ruling is provisional — either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties, on the 14 July 2026 trip from Blk 510 Bishan St 13 to Kallang Wave Mall (TRP-00103).

What the evidence shows. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00103 records 11.18 km against the booked optimal of 8.2 km on EV-TRIP-00103, an excess of 2.98 km or 36.34% of optimal. That passes both of POL-RD-01's establishment tests (greater than 0.8 km, greater than 20%), so a route deviation is established. Both of the trace's figures govern: POL-RD-01 requires the trace distance and expressly forbids citing the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 11.2 km. The deviation is not MATERIAL (under 8.0 km and under 50%), so POL-RD-06 does not require the driver-profile check; in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 553 completed_trips_90d, so no pattern, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral arises.

The closure explains the distance. The LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-00103-01 is a COMPLETE CLOSURE naming Braddell Road (towards Serangoon) between Lorong 1 Toa Payoh and Bishan Rd, the very arterial the booked optimal route uses, with a 05:30-12:00 window that covers the 08:07-08:36 trip. Under POL-RD-03 the whole measured excess is justified: the cap is 1.30 x (10.6 - 8.2) + 1.00 = 4.12 km, and 2.98 km sits inside it. The driver is not at fault for the distance, and the distance and time charges stand.

The rider is right about the ERP. You asked to be refunded at least the $4.00 of expressway ERP you were charged. EV-FARE-00103 itemises two gantries - CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) $3.00 and CTE (Moulmein Rd towards City) $1.00 - both recorded on_optimal_route false, off_optimal_route_total $4.00, while the booked optimal route carried no gantry at all (EV-TRIP-00103, optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.00). Because the deviation is exonerated as an external event under POL-RD-03, POL-RD-09(2) leaves the distance and time charges standing but refunds off-route ERP to the rider as a standalone pass-through correction, capped at $12.00 per trip. $4.00 is inside that cap. We refund $4.00. The total charged was $25.12 (EV-FARE-00103).

Why $4.00 and not $4.15. The rider's advocate pointed to the closure-adjusted recomputation on EV-FARE-00103 (refund_before_rounding $4.127 -> payable $4.15). That is a POL-RD-02 fare recomputation, and POL-RD-02 applies only where a deviation is established and no exculpatory clause FULLY excuses it. Here POL-RD-03 fully excuses the excess, so POL-RD-02 does not run, and the extra $0.15 within the $4.15 is a distance-and-time component that POL-RD-09(2) leaves standing. The refundable item is the $4.00 of off-route ERP, not the $4.15 closure arithmetic.

The driver's rider-instruction argument fails. The driver's advocate argued the rider's 'ok' at 08:12:58 was an instruction to take the CTE. POL-RD-04(a) requires the instruction to come from the rider, and (c) requires it to name a place or road specifically enough to act on. The road - the CTE - was named by the driver, not the rider, and a bare 'ok' names nothing; both messages on EV-CHAT-00103 carry waypoint_hint null. POL-RD-04 is therefore unavailable and POL-RD-09(3) is not engaged. POL-RD-14 confirms the point: a request the trace does not corroborate does not cause the excess, and no distance is excluded.

No billing-integrity fault. Both gantry lines are genuine crossings - the nearest trace fixes are 0.0 m (index 33) and 40.2 m (index 74), well inside POL-RD-09's 250 m match radius - so there is no phantom line and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral.

Confidence and next steps. Every artifact this ruling rests on is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 (EV-GPS-00103, EV-TRIP-00103, EV-FARE-00103, EV-ADVIS-00103-01, EV-CHAT-00103), so the confidence cap is 1.0 and our confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires: the trip identifiers match, the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) (175 fixes, 10-second interval, max gap 0.0 s, 100% coverage), the timestamps run forward, the advisory is on file, and both charge lines have counterparts in the trace. The $4.00 refund is at or below the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it is executed on issue. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Both parties: the driver took a materially longer route and I am refunding the whole SGD 65.13 that was charged.

ROUTE. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00105 is complete — 427 fixes at 10-second intervals, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0 s — so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and its figure governs over the rounded trip-record copy (POL-RD-01). It records 54.16 km driven against the 36.0 km booked optimal on EV-TRIP-00105: an excess of 18.16 km, or 50.44%. That clears both establishment gates and both materiality gates of POL-RD-01, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED and MATERIAL. The rider's measurement claim is accepted and the driver does not contest it.

EXCULPATION. None runs. The driver's statement that PIE traffic was heavy is unsupported by any traffic advisory. The bundle's only advisory, EV-ADVIS-00105-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT). The driver names no advisory ID, so under POL-RD-13(1) the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it and does not escalate under POL-RD-10(5); under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13(2) the uncited assertion carries no weight and the excess stands at the measured figure. POL-RD-03 is unavailable on this record. POL-RD-04 finds no rider instruction to detour in the chat log (EV-CHAT-00105); POL-RD-05 finds no amended pickup or dropoff; POL-RD-12 does not apply (vehicle_type RYDE_X, not pooled).

THE POL-RD-02 FIGURE. (Base fare 3.80 + 0.75 x 36.0 km + 0.28 x 42.0 min) x surge 1.0, read from EV-FARE-00105, the only artifact carrying the multiplier + platform fee 0.80 = recomputed_fare 43.36. Charged_total on EV-FARE-00105 is 65.13. Refund = 65.13 - 43.36 = 21.77, rounded up to 21.80 — 33.4% of the charge, below the 90% full-refund share. The driver's claim that the remedy is fixed at this figure is accepted as the POL-RD-02 figure and rejected as the final remedy, for the reason below.

THE POL-RD-06 UPLIFT. A MATERIAL deviation requires the driver-profile check, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d on EV-DPROF-00105 is 4, at or above the clause's threshold of 3; the repeat pattern is ESTABLISHED. The test is disjunctive, so the driver's point that the ratio limb (4/344 = 0.012) falls short does not help him, and prior_deviation_flags (6) is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting for the 90-day figure. EV-DPROF-00105 is impaired — issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT, weight_multiplier 0.75, its snapshot dated 108 hours before filing against a 72-hour currency threshold and four days before this trip — and I name that impairment here as POL-GEN-02(3) requires; the 4-against-3 finding survives the discount. Because the deviation is also MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own trace, POL-RD-06(b) replaces the POL-RD-02 partial with FULL_REFUND of charged_total. Side by side, as the clause requires: POL-RD-02 partial 21.80; POL-RD-06(b) uplifted figure 65.13. There is no government-set or third-party pass-through line to carve out — EV-FARE-00105 shows no ERP, no tolls and no airport surcharge (the Changi surcharge attaches only to trips ORIGINATING at an airport and this trip terminates there) — so the whole 65.13 is refunded.

POL-RD-09. No ERP or toll lines and no surcharge line, so there is nothing to itemise, no double-count risk under limb (1), and no billing-integrity defect under limb (4) for either side.

THE RIDER'S NARRATIVE. The rider is refunded the whole fare, but not because check-in was nearly missed: inconvenience is not a head of relief in this vocabulary and no artifact records a missed or nearly missed check-in, so that part of the claim adds nothing to the remedy.

CONFIDENCE AND ESCALATION. My confidence is capped at 0.75 under POL-GEN-02(2), the weight of EV-DPROF-00105, the only artifact carrying the repeat-pattern fact the uplift rests on. That is at or above the 0.70 confidence floor read from the loaded policy, so the case is decided rather than escalated; I have run each POL-RD-10 trigger and none fires. This ruling differs from precedents P-0001 and P-0002, which share POL-RD-01, POL-RD-02 and POL-RD-08 but carried no POL-RD-06 repeat-pattern finding: it is that finding on EV-DPROF-00105 that lifts this case from a partial to a full refund.

EXECUTION. The monetary effect, 65.13, exceeds the POL-GEN-05 threshold of 8.00, so this provisional ruling issues but the amount is held for release by a human reviewer. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties.

MEASUREMENT. The governing distance is the GPS trace EV-GPS-00104 at 34.17 km, not the rounded 34.2 km convenience copy on EV-TRIP-00104 (POL-RD-01). Against the booked optimal of 27.1 km the excess is 7.07 km — 26.09% of optimal and above 0.8 km — so the deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own trace, and the rider's threshold claim (POL-RD-01, POL-RD-07, POL-RD-08) is accepted. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c): 283 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, empty gaps array, maximum gap 0.0 s, so no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises.

THE DRIVER'S CLOSURE EXCUSE. EV-ADVIS-00104-01 (ADV-20260716-007), the LTA accident on the PIE towards Tuas after Eunos Link, names the corridor the optimal route itself uses, its 20:02–21:35 window straddles the trip, and the trace leaves that corridor before the affected segment and rejoins after, so POL-RD-03 applies and part of the excess is exonerated. The exoneration is capped: justified excess = min(7.07, 1.30 x (30.1 − 27.1) + 1.00) = min(7.07, 4.90) = 4.90 km. The closure-adjusted optimal is 27.10 + 4.90 = 32.00 km, and its duration scaled from the booked 34.0 min is 40.1 min.

THE DRIVER'S NO_ACTION ARGUMENT — REJECTED. The driver argues that measuring the excess against the adjusted optimal (34.17 − 32.00 = 2.17 km, 6.8%) puts it under the 20% gate, so no deviation survives. That is rejected. POL-RD-03 states in terms that excess beyond the cap 'is not exonerated and is refunded under POL-RD-02 computed against the closure-adjusted optimal route', and POL-RD-02 expressly directs the recomputation against the adjusted optimal where POL-RD-03 'excuses part of the excess'. To run the establishment gate against the adjusted optimal would leave that directive nothing to do and would let the closure excuse swallow the entire deviation, contrary to POL-RD-03's stated purpose of capping how far the closure can stretch. The deviation stands at the measured figure; the 2.17 km beyond the cap falls to be refunded.

THE RIDER'S COUNTER-REQUESTS. The excess cannot be moved onto the rider: the only rider message in EV-CHAT-00104 is 'ok but not too long ah', naming no place and no road, with waypoint_hint null, which fails POL-RD-04(a)-(c), and POL-RD-14 confirms that an instruction the trace does not corroborate excludes nothing (both rider and driver claims on this point are accepted; nothing is excluded).

THE ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02, POL-RD-09). Charged_total = 43.41 (EV-FARE-00104). Recomputed_fare against the closure-adjusted optimal = (3.80 + 0.75 x 32.00 + 0.28 x 40.1) x 1.00, the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus 0.80 platform fee = 39.828. Refund = 43.41 − 39.828 = 3.582, rounded UP to SGD 3.60. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and 8.3% of charged_total, far below the 90% share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND: recomputed against the unadjusted optimal the refund would have been SGD 9.00; the closure adjustment reduces it to SGD 3.60. There is no ERP, toll, airport-surcharge or waiting-time line to correct (erp_gantries empty, off-route ERP 0.00), so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and no billing-integrity referral arises.

DRIVER CONDUCT — NO REFERRAL. On the only POL-RD-06 fields, deviation_flags_90d is 1 (below 3) and 1/288 = 0.003 (below 0.05), so no repeat-deviation pattern is established, no FULL_REFUND uplift arises and no conduct referral is produced. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not used as a ground.

IMPAIRED ARTIFACT NOT RELIED ON. EV-ADVIS-00104-02, the operator-entered CTE breakdown, is IMPAIRED (weight 0.25; issue codes ADVISORY_UNCORROBORATED, UNVERIFIED_SOURCE) and its geometry covers a corridor this trip never enters. It is not relied on, so it excuses nothing and does not cap confidence; its impairment is disclosed here as POL-GEN-02 requires.

RIDER PROFILE. The POL-RD-08 additional-corroboration gate does not apply: deviation_claims_60d is 1 with 1 substantiated, and no other profile field is offered as a ground.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact — EV-GPS-00104, EV-TRIP-00104, EV-FARE-00104 and EV-ADVIS-00104-01 — carries weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; confidence is stated at 0.90.

EXECUTION AND APPEAL. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically. It was made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Both parties actually agree on the arithmetic; the case turns on the deviation finding and on how the fare is rebuilt.

Deviation. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00106, weight 1.0, COMPLETE) records 10.78 km over 169 fixes at an unbroken 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0 seconds. POL-RD-07 is therefore not engaged: none of limbs (a) to (c) fires, so the deviation is established on the trace alone and needs no independent corroboration. POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure to govern, not the rounded trip_record copy: measured against the booked optimal of 7.2 km (EV-TRIP-00106), the excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. That clears both establishment limbs (over 0.8 km and over 20%) but falls just short of both materiality limbs (not over 50%, not over 8.0 km). The deviation is ESTABLISHED, not MATERIAL. No POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is required, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 0 against completed_trips_90d of 96 would not support a repeat-pattern finding in any event, so no tie-break, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral arise.

No exculpatory clause runs. The bundle holds no traffic advisory for the 08:29-09:03 window: EV-ADVIS-00106-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and neither party asserts an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and POL-RD-13 confirms that an uncited traffic excuse carries no weight. The single chat message (EV-CHAT-00106, weight 1.0) is the rider's own complaint at 08:46:30, 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us', not an instruction, and its waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable (POL-RD-14). There is no pickup or dropoff amendment (POL-RD-05), the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null (POL-RD-11 does not run), and the vehicle is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not displace the 7.2 km booked optimal).

Remedy. Under POL-RD-02 the refund is arithmetic. charged_total 26.04. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 7.2 km = 5.40 + 0.28 x 19.0 min = 5.32) x surge 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP on the optimal route = 15.32. Refund = 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% share that would promote it to FULL_REFUND, rounded UP to a payable of SGD 10.75.

The $5.50 of ERP. Both gantries, CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) at $3.00 and CTE (Chin Swee Rd tunnel, towards City) at $2.50, are genuine crossings: the trace passes 0.0 m and 24.1 m from them, well inside the 250 m match radius, so there is no phantom line and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity refund, and no referral follows. Because the optimal route carries no gantry (trip_record.optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.00), the whole $5.50 is already comprehended inside the POL-RD-02 recomputation. POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding it on top; awarding $26.04 or $16.25 would charge the driver twice for the same ERP. That is why NO_ACTION, which on this rider-filed dispute would leave the rider carrying all $26.04 including ERP for tunnels the optimal route never uses, is not the outcome the evidence supports.

Rider: the charge is corrected and SGD 10.75 is returned to you. Driver: the deviation is measured but not material, and no pattern, conduct or billing-integrity finding is made against you.

Confidence is 0.95. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact - EV-GPS-00106 (trace distance), EV-TRIP-00106 (booked optimal) and EV-FARE-00106 (charges and fare model) - stands at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; the MISSING advisory at weight 0.0 carries no fact and does not drag the cap down. The monetary effect of SGD 10.75 exceeds the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the ruling issues but is not executed automatically and is placed in the human queue for release. This ruling matches the earlier PARTIAL_REFUND precedents on POL-RD-01, POL-RD-02 and POL-RD-08; the 49.72% excess here keeps the deviation non-material and confines the remedy to the arithmetic partial refund.

Rider and Driver, this is the decision on trip TRP-00107 (Ang Mo Kio to One Raffles Place, 18 July 2026).

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. Under POL-RD-01 the governing measurement is the GPS trace figure, not the trip record's rounded copy. The trace records 17.57 km (EV-GPS-00107) against the platform's booked optimal of 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-00107), an excess of 3.57 km — 25.5% of optimal, over the 20% gate, and over the 0.8 km absolute gate. Both tests pass. It is NOT a material deviation (25.5% is under the 50% limb and 3.57 km is under the 8.0 km limb), so the POL-RD-06 uplift to FULL_REFUND and the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral do not arise.

THE GPS TRACE IS IMPAIRED FOR ADMISSIBILITY BUT NOT FOR POLICY — both things are true. EV-GPS-00107 carries a schema impairment at weight_multiplier 0.30, issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final Raffles Place approach and the impossible speeds it necessarily implies). It does NOT meet the POL-RD-07 policy limbs: no gap over 90 s (max gap 0.0 s), no jump over 500 m, and no sustained interval over 30 s (10 s sampling, 100% coverage). A deviation may therefore be established on it.

ON CONFIDENCE AND ESCALATION (the Driver's principal point). The Driver argues confidence is capped at 0.30 and the case must escalate under POL-RD-10(1). That is rejected. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, but where two or more INDEPENDENT artifacts carry that fact the cap is the MAXIMUM. The fact that this vehicle left the CTE corridor and went by Whitley through Novena, Newton and Kim Seng Road is carried independently by the chat log (EV-CHAT-00107, weight 1.0) — a contemporaneous exchange from inside the trip window in which the rider puts the Whitley exit to the driver and the driver answers only about traffic, never denying the route. The cap is therefore 1.0, not 0.30, and no POL-RD-10(1) escalation follows. The Driver's own account to the same effect sits in his counterparty statement, which is evidence but, having no weight_multiplier, does not itself move the cap.

THE TRAFFIC EXCUSE DOES NOT HELP THE DRIVER. He says the CTE into town was jammed near Chin Swee. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic advisory naming the affected road, with a validity window and a matching route; the bundle holds no advisory for this trip (EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the bare assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. NO EXONERATION. POL-RD-04 does not apply: the only rider message is a question about the Whitley exit sent after the corridor was already left, naming no waypoint (waypoint_hint is null) — it is not a detour instruction. THE REFUND (POL-RD-02), METERED, surge 1.35 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier — the only artifact that carries it:

- refund: 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, rounded UP to SGD 7.45.

SGD 7.45 is above the 0.50 de minimis, and at 20.3% of the charge it is far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.45. The rider's estimate of SGD 12.00 exceeds what the policy yields; the arithmetic governs. There are no ERP, toll or surcharge lines (POL-RD-09), so nothing is added on top.

POL-RD-08. The rider's counters (5 deviation claims in 60 days, 1 substantiated) require corroboration beyond the trace for an excess under 30%. It exists: the Driver's counterparty statement admits the route, an independent source on the POL-RD-07(ii) list. The fare-ledger distance, by contrast, is derived from the same trace and is not independent corroboration.

NO PATTERN (POL-RD-06). deviation_flags_90d is 1 (under the 3-or-more limb) and 1 divided by 619 completed trips is 0.0016 (under the 0.05 limb), so no pattern is established — no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01.

The monetary effect (SGD 7.45) is at or below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

To both parties. The $33.77 charge stands and no refund is due.

The rider's figures. The rider's comparison against 21.0 km is the booked Rivervale-to-T1 estimate that her own two amendments replaced; it is not the governing baseline, and the derived 5.17 km / 24.6% excess in the GPS block is measured against that superseded figure. Trip TRP-00109 (Clementi MRT to Bukit Batok MRT). Disputed amount SGD 12.00. The rider's fare stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.15.

Nothing on the trace shows any departure from the optimal corridor other than that requested stop, so the whole 7.36 km excess is excluded and no deviation is established. POL-RD-02 therefore does not run and no distance-or-time refund is due: the arithmetic the rider's advocate offered — charged_total 21.32 less recomputed_fare 13.32 = 8.00 — is correct as arithmetic but is not payable, because the deviation that would trigger it is exonerated. The rider's argument that the exonerated portion is unmeasurable is rejected: the record identifies one departure and one cause, so the off-corridor excess is the measured excess, and the rider's fallback request to escalate under POL-RD-10 is refused for the same reason, no POL-RD-10 limb having fired.

2. THE DRIVER WAS UNDER-BILLED AND IS COMPENSATED. The fare breakdown charges for 9.60 km (EV-FARE-00109) while the trace records 13.76 km — a shortfall of 4.16 km, above the 1.0 km trigger in POL-RD-04. At SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre that is SGD 3.12, rounded UP to SGD 3.15, within the SGD 15.00 cap. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries that same SGD 3.15; the rider's contested charge stands.

3. POINTS ANSWERED TOGETHER. Trace integrity: both sides agree and the record confirms the trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 (207 fixes, 10 s interval, no gaps, maximum gap 0 s), so no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arise, and POL-RD-14 is not engaged because the trace did corroborate the instruction. Traffic: no traffic cause was asserted by either party, so POL-RD-03 is not invoked; the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-00109-01 (MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) is disclosed and decides nothing, and POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-10(5) do not fire. Driver profile: POL-RD-06 was consulted and no pattern is established — deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 511 completed trips in 90 days — so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral; the lifetime prior_deviation_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used. Burden: the rider did discharge the POL-RD-08 initial burden from an unimpaired trace, shifting it to the driver, who discharged it with a specific artifact and clause (EV-CHAT-00109 with POL-RD-04); the rider's own profile (deviation_claims_60d = 1) does not engage the heightened corroboration test, so her claim was not denied on that basis. Pass-throughs: the fare carries no ERP, toll or airport-surcharge lines, so POL-RD-09 has nothing to refund and produces no referral. Confidence: every artifact carrying a deciding fact — the chat log, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown — is at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no POL-GEN-02(3) naming is required. Execution: the monetary effect (SGD 3.15) is below the POL-GEN-05 threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically. Precedents P-0001 and P-0002 are PARTIAL_REFUND under POL-RD-01/02/08; this case differs because the chat log's resolved waypoint_hint, corroborated on the driving trace to within 37.94 m, exonerates the detour under POL-RD-04 before POL-RD-02 is reached.

To the rider and the driver. This is decided on the trip's own records, TRP-00111.

1. The distance. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00111 records 29.98 km travelled against a booked optimal of 24.0 km on EV-TRIP-00111: an excess of 5.98 km, or 24.9% of optimal. That passes both of POL-RD-01's gates (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED. Both advocates agree on this and I accept it, using the trace figure as POL-RD-01 requires (the trip record's rounded 30.0 km is not used for the test).

2. The closure. The bundle carries a real LTA record, EV-ADVIS-00111-01: a HIGH-severity closure of the Pan Island Expressway towards Tuas after the Clementi Rd exit (between Clementi Rd and Jalan Anak Bukit), in force 07:10–09:30 on 3 Aug 2026, overlapping the whole trip (07:47:40–08:25:40), with the diversion stated as Upper Bukit Timah Rd. The booked optimal route is 'BKE southbound then PIE westbound' (EV-TRIP-00111, optimal_route_source), so the advisory names the expressway and the segment the optimal route uses; the trace leaves that corridor at Bukit Panjang before the closed segment and rejoins it on the AYE after it. All three limbs of POL-RD-03 are met and the deviation is EXONERATED.

3. The cap. POL-RD-03 exonerates at most min(measured 5.98 km, 1.30 x (29.2 - 24.0) + 1.00) = min(5.98, 7.76) = 5.98 km. The cap does not bite, so the whole excess is justified and nothing is left over as a refundable overcharge.

4. The fare. Even running POL-RD-02 against the closure-adjusted optimal (24.0 + 5.98 = 29.98 km, duration 30.0 x 29.98/24.0 = 37.5 min), the recomputed fare is (3.80 + 0.75 x 29.98 + 0.28 x 37.5) x 1.0 + 0.80 = 37.585, against charged_total 37.74. The difference is 0.155, which is below the SGD 0.50 de-minimis threshold, so no refundable amount remains and the charge stands.

5. The rider's objections, answered together. I reject the argument that POL-RD-03 cannot be run because the optimal route's polyline is absent from the record: the clause asks whether the advisory names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, and the booked optimal route's own source names PIE westbound - the corridor the advisory closes. The derived trace-area figure was one input, not the whole basis. The rider's statement 'I did not see any closure' cites no evidence ID and carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The rider's pleaded alternative, that POL-RD-10(5) should escalate because the driver's clause lacks the field it needs, fails: the advisory is in the pool, covers the trip window, and carries the road, window and geometry the clause requires, so no POL-RD-10(5) trigger fires.

6. The other clauses. No distance is excluded as rider-requested under POL-RD-04: the chat log's only rider message ('as long as i reach by 8.30') is not an instruction, and waypoint_hint is null, so the clause is unavailable. Nothing is refundable under POL-RD-09: tolls_erp is 0.00, erp_gantries is empty, and no ERP or surcharge line exists to correct (POL-RD-09(2) has nothing to pass through). No driver compensation is due under POL-RD-04: the billed distance is 30.0 km, which is not less than the 29.98 km travelled.

7. No escalation and no referral. The trace is clean at policy level (229 fixes, 10 s sampling, no gaps, 100% coverage), the trip identifiers and timestamps match across the trip record, trace and fare record, every charge line reconciles, and the driver's defence rests on a present advisory that covers the trip window - so no POL-RD-10 trigger fires. No repeat-deviation pattern is established (deviation_flags_90d 0 of 588 trips), the deviation is not material (24.9% and 5.98 km, under the 50%/8.0 km test), and there is no billing-integrity defect, so no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral and no POL-RD-09(4) billing referral is made. All evidence used here carries weight_multiplier 1.0, so no discount or narration under POL-GEN-02 applies.

Outcome: NO_ACTION - the rider's claim is not supported on the evidence and the charged fare of SGD 37.74 stands. The monetary effect is zero, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. Earlier cases P-0001 and P-0002 (POL-RD-01/02/08) ended in partial refunds; the difference here is the live LTA closure advisory EV-ADVIS-00111-01 matching the optimal corridor and the trip window, which exonerated the whole of the excess.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver. This case cannot be decided on the record, so it goes to a human reviewer and no money moves in the meantime. The disputed SGD 10.00 is held, not refunded and not collected.

The figures. The trip of 22 July 2026 ran from Compass One, Sengkang, to Marina Bay Financial Centre. The platform's optimal route for the booking is 18.4 km and 26 minutes (KPE then ECP). The trip was billed at 21.2 km and 39 minutes, total SGD 34.42: base fare 3.80, distance 15.90, time 10.92, ERP 3.00 and platform fee 0.80. The excess over optimal is 2.8 km, or 15.22%. POL-RD-01's gate needs an excess over both 20% of optimal (3.68 km) and 0.8 km. On those figures the gate is not cleared.

Why that does not decide it. The governing distance is the GPS trace, and EV-GPS-00110 is impaired. It carries a 428.0-second gap between 18:35:00 and 18:42:08, bounded by the Defu Flyover and Kallang portal fixes 6.9 km apart, and the gap covers the entire stretch the rider disputes, through the KPE tunnel. That is over POL-RD-07's own 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired for policy and not merely for the schema pre-pass: weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 81.7%, below 90.0). POL-RD-07(i) makes me read the gap as the straight line between the bounding fixes - the reading most favourable to the driver - and that reading is the 21.20 km above. A surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km and would clear the gate. Nothing in this bundle tells me which of the two happened, so the 15.22% is a product of the missing data, not a finding that the driver stayed on the optimal corridor.

Corroboration. POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on an impaired trace without one of four independent sources, and none is present. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00110, impaired, weight 0.6, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) has only 'going KPE ah boss' and 'ok' and no admission - the KPE is the optimal corridor itself - and it stops at 18:26:14, 2186 s before the trip ended. The fare breakdown's erp_gantries is null, so no charged gantry places the car off-corridor. The driver's statement confirms the KPE, again the optimal corridor, and admits no diversion. The trip record's 21.2 km is a copy of the impaired trace, as its own admissibility note concedes. So nothing independent carries the distance fact.

The result. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists: the absence of proof is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-01's default of NO_ACTION does not apply, because the reading that fails the gate is itself an artefact of the gap. Escalation is terminal: no amount is refunded, no amount is collected, and the SGD 10.00 stays held.

Confidence. The deciding distance fact is carried by EV-GPS-00110 alone at weight 0.39; the trip record copies it and the fare ledger is not independent, so nothing raises the cap under POL-GEN-02(2). Confidence is 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, which independently trips POL-RD-10(1).

What would resolve it. An ERP gantry itemisation for this trip (gantry name, coordinates and entry time) showing whether the car crossed gantries the KPE/ECP optimal route does not use; or a GPS export with fixes inside the 18:35-18:42 tunnel stretch; or a driver admission of the route actually driven. Under POL-GEN-04 an appeal may add exactly this kind of record-type evidence.

The driver's points. Your point that the measured excess (2.8 km, 15.22%) fails the POL-RD-01 gate is correct as far as it goes, but it cannot be turned into NO_ACTION: the measurement is taken on an impaired trace, and POL-RD-07(iii) says the outcome is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION. Your points that the trip record is not an independent source, that the billed distance is not corroboration, that the rider has shown no independent source, that the chat is consistent with the optimal corridor, and that 15.22% is not a material deviation (below 50% and 8.0 km) are all accepted. Your point on ERP is accepted: there are no gantry lines at all, and the SGD 3.00 matches the trip record's own optimal-route ERP of 3.00, so no billing-integrity refund arises and no POL-RD-09(4) referral is made. Your observation that the impaired-trace branch produces ESCALATE is also accepted. No POL-RD-06(c) referral is made: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 744, so no pattern exists.

The rider's points. Your points that the trace is impaired for policy (428 s gap, weight 0.39), that the chat supplies no corroboration, that the fare ledger cannot carry the point (erp_gantries null; the charged distance is a copy of the trace), and that the trip record is not an independent source are all accepted. Your point that no extra corroboration burden attaches under POL-RD-08 is also accepted: deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and the profile fields are context only under POL-GEN-01.

Precedent. Earlier cases on these clauses ended PARTIAL_REFUND; what separates this one is that the only distance measurement is an impaired GPS trace with no POL-RD-07(ii) independent source, so no refund can be computed and POL-RD-10(3) applies instead.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

The SGD 2.00 Adam Road gantry (EV-FARE-00114) is the only off-route ERP line and is already comprehended inside the recomputation, so it is itemised for transparency but never added on top; the SGD 2.50 Kim Keat Link gantry lies on the optimal route and is properly chargeable. The 1.6 surge is applied as the rider accepted. No escalation trigger fired: the trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (100% coverage, 10 s interval, no gaps, max gap 0), the trip identifiers match across the artifacts, both billed gantries match the trace within the 250 m radius (nearest fixes at 0.0 m and 8.76 m), and the refund is far below SGD 150.00. Confidence is 0.95, well above the 0.70 floor, and is capped at 1.0 by the weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts (EV-GPS-00114, EV-TRIP-00114, EV-FARE-00114). Because the SGD 13.70 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, the amount is issued but held for release under POL-GEN-05. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider: your claim is measured against the wrong baseline, and even on the correct one the deviation does not reach the policy threshold. This was a RYDE_POOL booking (EV-TRIP-00113, vehicle_type RYDE_POOL). Under POL-RD-12 the baseline for a pooled trip is the matched-itinerary optimal the platform quoted at match time — 19.40 km on the trip record — and not the 15.80 km solo-rider figure, which the record carries as reference only. Your '28% longer' figure is arithmetic against the 15.80 km field, and POL-RD-12 says a claim measured that way fails on that ground alone. The governing distance is the GPS trace figure of 20.18 km (EV-GPS-00113, trace_distance_km; POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern and bars citation of the rounded 20.2 km copy). Excess = 20.18 − 19.40 = 0.78 km, or 4.02%. POL-RD-01 requires both more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20%; 0.78 km falls 20 metres short of the absolute limb and 4.02% is far below the percentage limb. No deviation is established, so no refund arises under POL-RD-02. The Hougang stop you pointed to is not a detour: it is the platform-matched co-rider pickup, recorded as a 90-second standstill at Hougang Central at 19:03:40, and POL-RD-12 excludes distance spent collecting a co-rider on a matched pooled itinerary before the threshold test is applied. The platform told you of the pooled route and its 19.40 km estimate at 18:42:04, six minutes before the 18:47:10 start. To the driver: your account is accepted. The matched-itinerary baseline of 19.40 km stands, the Hougang leg is platform-matched and not chargeable to you, and no exculpatory clause needed to be invoked because the claim fails on measurement. POL-RD-04 is unavailable (the only rider message, at 19:02:40, asks a question and names no waypoint) and POL-RD-05 is unavailable (amendment timestamps and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null), so nothing adjusts the baseline. On billing integrity, EV-FARE-00113 shows no ERP gantry, no airport surcharge and no unmatched line; its components reconcile to the 26.83 charged and the 3.00 pool discount is already applied, so POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to correct. EV-ADVIS-00113-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; that absence is not an escalation trigger, because no party asserted an external traffic cause — your account is the pool match under POL-RD-12 — so POL-RD-03 was never invoked and POL-RD-13(1) confirms the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it, leaving POL-RD-10(5) unengaged. EV-GPS-00113 is unimpaired for policy purposes (217 fixes, 100% coverage, 10-second interval, no gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s), so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged. No material deviation exists, so POL-RD-06 is not required; in any event the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 471 completed trips, so no repeat pattern and no POL-RD-06(c) referral. No profile field was used to establish any fact about this trip (POL-GEN-01). Outcome: NO_ACTION — the charge of 26.83 stands as it is, nothing is refunded, no compensation is due, and the monetary effect is zero, below the 8.00 execution threshold. The earlier decisions P-0001 and P-0002 are PARTIAL_REFUND on a shared clause set, but each rested on a POL-RD-01 excess that was actually established; here this trip's trace yields 0.78 km, below the absolute limb, so there is no deviation to refund.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver.

WHAT WAS DECIDED. Part of the contested SGD 6.00 is returned: SGD 2.00 is refunded to the rider, and the rest of the charge stands. The disputed amount is not held; because the monetary effect (SGD 2.00) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, this ruling executes automatically.

THE ROUTE. The deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own trace. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km govern, so the figure is 28.18 km against the booked optimal of 22.4 km on EV-TRIP-00115 - an excess of 5.78 km, 25.8%. Both POL-RD-01 gates pass (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km absolute). Taken with the rider's POL-RD-01 claim and the driver's own acknowledgement of the excess.

WHY THAT DOES NOT PRODUCE A DISTANCE REFUND. EV-FARE-00115 shows fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 34.50. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking and POL-RD-02 does not run, so no distance-or-time refund is available however large the excess. Both advocates' claims on this point (the rider's POL-RD-11/POL-RD-02 claim, the driver's POL-RD-11 claim) are accepted: the rider's request to 'refund the extra distance' is rejected on the fare model itself. POL-RD-11 does not excuse the excess; it only moves where the money sits.

NO FULL_REFUND UPLIFT, NO CONDUCT REFERRAL. The excess of 25.8% is below POL-RD-01's materiality gates (more than 50%, or more than 8.0 km), so the deviation is not MATERIAL and no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) is available. The driver_profile check also comes out clean: deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d 523, nowhere near POL-RD-06's limbs. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags may not be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure POL-RD-06 names (POL-GEN-01); it was mentioned only as a field that cannot be used, and nothing was built on it. No POL-RD-06(c) referral arises.

THE ERP LINES. Charged total was 39.00 against the 34.50 quote. The KPE (Defu Flyover towards ECP) line of SGD 2.50 is properly chargeable: it lies on the booked optimal route and the 100%-coverage trace crosses it at 44.5 m, inside the POL-RD-09(4) 250 m radius. It stays. The AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas) line of SGD 2.00 is a phantom charge: the line is off the optimal route and the trace's closest approach is 5,419.3 m against the same 250 m radius. Both advocates agree on this and the driver's statement that he never went near the AYE is corroborated, not contradicted. Under POL-RD-09(4) that line is refunded in full as a standalone billing-integrity correction, available whether or not a deviation exists, and it is recorded in the referrals above.

THE ARITHMETIC. 39.00 (charged_total, EV-FARE-00115) less 34.50 (quoted_fare_sgd) less 2.50 (the one properly chargeable ERP pass-through, KPE) = 2.00. There is no airport surcharge (the trip does not originate at an airport) and the waiting_time_fee is 0.00. Rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 the refund remains SGD 2.00. POL-RD-11(b) adds nothing on top: the off-route AYE line is already excluded from the properly chargeable total, and refunding it again would refund it twice.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXPLANATION. The claim that CTE traffic made the KPE/TPE route necessary is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else. EV-ADVIS-00115-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; no LTA advisory covers the CTE, KPE or TPE in the 21:06-21:48 window. POL-RD-03 cannot be run, and under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight and reduces no excess. The rider's and the driver's claims to that effect are accepted. The impairment is disclosed here as POL-GEN-02(3) requires: the artifact is EV-ADVIS-00115-01, its weight is 0.0, its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT, and it carries no fact in this ruling. Its absence does not escalate the case: the driver named no advisory identifier, so this is not a clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5) (POL-RD-13(1)), and the uncompensated traffic excuse costs the driver nothing on distance or time because the fare was already fixed.

THE CHAT AND POL-RD-04. The chat is two messages: the driver's 'CTE very heavy boss, i go KPE then TPE' at 21:14:10 and the rider's 'ok' at 21:14:50. That is the driver's announcement, not a rider instruction, and waypoint_hint is null on both messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot be met by either side and gives neither exoneration. It does show the reroute was disclosed rather than concealed, and the driver's claim to that effect is accepted as context only. POL-RD-04's driver-compensation limb does not apply either: the fare was a flat upfront quote with no distance billed (distance_charged_km is null), and POL-RD-11 provides that on an upfront fare the driver's unrecovered detour cost is not recoverable from the rider.

NO ESCALATION. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 100% coverage, 229 fixes at a 10 s cadence, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) never fire and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The trip identifiers on the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown all read TRP-00115, and the timestamps do not conflict. The only unmatched charge line is the AYE line refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-10(8) expressly carves out. The refund is far below both charged_total and POL-RD-10(6)'s SGD 150.00 ceiling. No trigger in POL-RD-10 fires, and both advocates' claims that the case is decidable are accepted. The single discarded claim in the audit record below was discarded by the referee for non-disclosure of an impairment, not on the merits.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute goes to a human reviewer and the disputed SGD 6.00 is held rather than collected or refunded (POL-RD-10; POL-GEN-03).

Why it cannot be finally decided. The two artifacts that measure this trip cannot agree when it began. EV-TRIP-00112 puts the pickup/start at 18:32:10; EV-GPS-00112 begins at 18:18:40 and covers 2.38 km before that moment. That is a 13 minute 30 second disagreement, beyond the 10-minute limb in POL-RD-10(4), and it decides the threshold test: read over the whole trace the trip is 22.40 km against a 17.6 km optimal, an excess of 4.80 km / 27.3% that clears POL-RD-01's 20% and 0.8 km gates and establishes a deviation; read from the recorded started_at only 20.02 km was driven, an excess of 2.42 km / 13.8% that fails them. The admissibility report itself records that nothing in the bundle decides which reading is correct. The driver's account that the app kept showing the trip as not started is an assertion that does not dissolve a contradiction the policy makes its own escalation ground, and on the other point he is contradicted by the trace.

Confidence. The deciding fact — the start-time conflict — is carried only by EV-TRIP-00112 and EV-GPS-00112, each rated weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, so under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence is capped at 0.4. That is below the 0.70 floor, which also triggers POL-RD-10(1) on its own. I record that this is schema-level impairment, not policy-level impairment: under POL-RD-07 the trace is clean (no gap over 90 s, no fix-to-fix jump over 500 m, a steady 10-second sampling interval, 100% coverage), so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged and I do not treat the trace as unusable for policy purposes.

For the reviewer, the arithmetic if a deviation is established. The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 recomputes the optimal fare at 25.64 — (3.80 base + 0.75 x 17.6 km + 0.28 x 28.0 min) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from EV-FARE-00112, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, surcharge or waiting charge — against the 25.26 charged, leaving a refund of nil, below the 0.50 de minimis. The driver's claim to SGD 1.80 for 2.40 unbilled km under POL-RD-04 rests on the same contested trace figure and likewise cannot be resolved here. There is no off-route ERP, toll, surcharge or phantom line to correct under POL-RD-09, and no POL-RD-06 referral: the deviation is not material (27.3% and 4.80 km are below the 50% and 8.0 km limbs) and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 1 against 296 completed trips establishes no pattern.

The Paya Lebar Quarter complaint adds nothing to any amount. The rider's request and the driver's 'ok can' are in EV-CHAT-00112, but the trace never comes within the 200 m corroboration test (nearest fix 512.35 m from the waypoint), so under POL-RD-14 the instruction is uncorroborated, excludes no distance, and no charge was levied for the stop in any event. No corroboration uplift applies to this rider under POL-RD-08 (deviation_claims_60d 1, substantiated 0), and no traffic advisory covers the trip window (EV-ADVIS-00112-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0), so no external-cause exoneration arises.

What would resolve it on review: a record fixing when this trip truly started — a meter or booking log showing the meter start, or a GPS export placing the trace's first 2.38 km in a prior job — would let the excess be measured on a single window and end the dispute.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
